items.title: Disney Is Near Its High. Morgan Stanley Still Sees 14% Upside
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMorgan Stanley raised its Disney price target to $138 from $133 and kept its Overweight rating, after updating its estimates for Disney’s fiscal 2026 results. Disney beat its own guidance for fiscal 2026 and guided to double-digit adjusted EPS growth in fiscal 2027, excluding an extra week.
